text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, not bad at all, me.
It's okay, I still got solid results—
(WOOOAAAH...!!)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...!?
What is this voice—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, thanks for cheering!
Heheh, pretty cool, wasn't I?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
This isn't all I've got, you know!
Don't take your eyes off my performance!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I promise you right here and now
that I'll keep exceeding everyone's expectations!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well then!
This was Tokai Teio~♪
(WOOOAAAH...!!)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Look at that huge hype.
Seriously, you never disappoint.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...This is so stupid.
Talking about challenging a girl like that, like I ever had a chance.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "And in the end, that's as far as you go. Talk about not knowing your place."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Such an idiot, honestly...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Aah.
It's so bright...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: âAh, Trainer-san...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Umm...
Nice Nature, reporting back~
choice_data_list: You really hung in there, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Haha...
Save it, save it, I don't need that kind of pity.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I mean, look, I delivered on the order, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Delivering results "as usual."
Yep, I got the job done properly.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "...Like I said, all that talk about a 'challenge' was totally unnecessary."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
If I hadn't thought about that,
everything really would have just been business as usual.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...My feelings too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Aaah!
The sparkles are way too far away!
Indeed, just as she says, this result is remarkably good. Even if she didn't take first place, she has every reason to take it more positively.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

However, she's feeling down.
Perhaps her lack of self-confidence plays a part.
If so, what she needs is—
choice_data_list: Nature, wanna go on an expedition?
Nature, wanna go on an expedition?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "An expedition...? Wait, why...?"
choice_data_list: Let's keep getting results through the summer

text_block_list.text:
Putting her in the Classic campaign right now is a dangerous gamble.
It might shatter even the little confidence she currently has.

More importantly, taking on local races
and steadily racking up results will surely
benefit her growth in the long run.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
In other words... you're not aiming for
either the Satsuki Sho or the Japanese Derby...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Because I'm not good enough.
choice_data_list: Let's not rush for now, and steadily build up our strength.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You're right. The way I am right now...
Even if I entered a big race, there's no way I'd win.
choice_data_list: If you push through this summer, you'll become even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...I sure hope so.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Mm, okay, okay!
Touring around from place to place actually kinda suits me anyway.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
So? You're not seriously going to make me
tour the rural boondocks, are you?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Which race are you aiming for in the end?

A graded race held in Kokura.
It's the perfect race to help build
Nice Nature's confidence.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I see, the distance is the same as the Wakagoma, right?
Yeah, let's do that.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Still, Kokura in summer, huh...
I'm gonna melt..."

And so, it was decided that we'd aim
for the Kokura Kinen next!
